name: Slow
description: Uses the least fuel, and has the longest Duration.

name: Fast
description: A shorter Duration, so Assets arrive sooner and do more research this Turn. The extra fuel costs money and mass.

name: Free-return
description: Swings back to Earth if the arrival burn fails, rather than losing the Mission. It costs extra however the Mission goes.

freeReturn.description: The engine didn't fire for long enough, and the spacecraft swung back past Mars on its way home to Earth.
